revisions.note: Receipt-driven handoff replacing the A31/A32 time/gap rule: mode=receipt in configs/nuxel/boot/animation-handoff.json, min_cycles=1 (one complete 192-frame/24fps play-through = 8000 ms), single-/dev/fb0-owner lock (/run/nuxel-fb-owner.lock + durable /var/lib/nuxel/fb-owner), NUXEL_ANIM_HANDOFF receipt=<id> owner=<anim|ui>, ANIM_MIN_CYCLE/ANIMATION_STOP/LAUNCHER_DISPLAY/ANIM_LOOP markers, launcher-not-ready resumes the animation (no blank/static frame), bounded max_wait_s=24 with explicit ANIM_MIN_CYCLE_DEGRADED. A33 also added build-a33-boot.sh (nothing built this bridge before) and run-boot-tests.sh (one gate for all five bg-02 briQs). Evidence here is a decision table, a compiled binary and a harness - none of which can see the panel, so the on-glass verdict stays NEEDS_OWNER_TEST.

revisions.note: Revision 3 (bg-02 verification pass, resume & re-verify). RE-VERIFIED against the protected baseline, no change to the handoff semantics: the bridge source is byte-identical to revision 2 (052bfdbf...) and the A32 conversion pin INV-2 still matches. What changed around it: (a) the animation policy is now a real, persisted control (configs/nuxel/boot/verbose-boot.json -> animation_mode + verbosity_level with the single precedence off > short > verbose_boot > standard), so a waived minimum-cycle floor now carries a RECORDED REASON (animation_mode_off | animation_mode_short | verbose_boot_requested) through /run/nuxel/anim-skip.request and the new NUXEL_BOOT_ANIMATION marker instead of an unnamed waiver; (b) Settings -> Developer now carries the full Boot diagnostics panel the briQ asks for (standard animation, persistent verbose boot, verbosity level); (c) docs/beta-finalization/boot/ANIMATION-HANDOFF.md gained the flash-free deployment hand-off for bg-10 (exact artefacts, install paths, pre-checks, rollback, deploy order that keeps one fb owner, DEPLOYED_UNVERIFIED until live receipts exist) and the launcher cache namespace was bumped v4-a33 -> v5-a33 for the changed bundle. Honest limits recorded: the UTM guest was NOT reachable this revision, so the aarch64 build leg and the binary colour layer were SKIPPED (never a pass) and VM parity stays bg-11's; bash tools/beta/regression-guard.sh reports FAIL=1 on INV-4 configs/nuxel/buttons.json, an in-flight edit by the parallel button group (bg-03) that this briQ neither owns nor touched - it is the only FAIL and it is not a bg-02 regression. No kernel/initramfs change: the one-time Bixby-hold override stays BLOCKED_KERNEL/BOOT_UPDATE_REQUIRED and NO Samsung magic reboot string exists anywhere on the boot surface (asserted by the contract test).
